question: If tan θ + cot θ = 13, then find the value of 8 tan2 θ + 8 cot2 θ.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: **tan θ + cot θ = 13**

Using the algebraic identity: if **x + 1/x = k**, then **x² + 1/x² = k² − 2**

Since **cot θ = 1/tan θ**, we have **tan² θ + cot² θ = 13² − 2 = 169 − 2 = 167**

Required value = **8 × (tan² θ + cot² θ) = 8 × 167**

**∴ The correct answer is 1336.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** tan θ + cot θ = 13

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c36366f734266d6a2cf6ca02ed1378176ddf9b55988e781b6ec21cad71457a8.png] 

⇒ (tan θ + cot θ)² = 13²

⇒ tan² θ + cot² θ + 2 × tan θ × cot θ = 169

⇒ Since tan θ × cot θ = 1, we get tan² θ + cot² θ + 2 = 169

⇒ tan² θ + cot² θ = 169 − 2 = 167

⇒ Now, multiply the entire expression by 8:

⇒ 8 × (tan² θ + cot² θ) = 8 × 167

⇒ 8 tan² θ + 8 cot² θ = 1336

**∴ The correct answer is 1336.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Identities

The product of **tan θ** and **cot θ** is always 1 because they are reciprocals of each other (cot θ = 1/tan θ).

Algebraic Squared Relation

For any variable and its reciprocal x + 1/x = a, the value of x² + 1/x² is always calculated as **a² − 2**.

Trigonometric Squares

Standard identities include **1 + tan² θ = sec² θ** and **1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ**, which are useful for complex conversions.</p
